question: When will these shirts and t-shirts actually ship?
answer: We are currently in our pre-launch demand validation phase. We do not manufacture speculative excess inventory. Once we reach 1,000 genuine inquiries across our community, we will finalize our organic cotton mills, send pre-order invitations to supporters with their chosen sizes reserved, and initiate batch printing. Estimated delivery timeline is 4-6 weeks after the goal is reached.

question: Do I need to pay or enter card details now?
answer: No, absolutely not. There is no cart, checkout, or payment system on this site. Submitting your inquiry registers your interest and secures your place on the early supporter list at zero cost. We only contact you when manufacturing begins.

question: Can I change my size or design preference later?
answer: Yes. When we reach the 1,000 milestone and reach out via your preferred channel (WhatsApp or Email), you will receive a direct link to review your selections and adjust your fit, color, or shipping address before any order is finalized.

question: How and how often will you contact me?
answer: We hate spam just as much as you do. We only send critical milestone updates (e.g. 500 supporters, 1,000 unlock achieved) and your personal early-supporter notification via WhatsApp or Email as per your choice. You can opt out at any time.

question: How is my personal information protected?
answer: We strictly adhere to India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act. Your WhatsApp number, email, and city are collected solely to validate interest for this drop and communicate launch timelines. We never share, sell, or monetize your contact details, and we provide an instant data deletion request path.
